<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="xpath" initial="a">
  <state id="a">
    <onentry><script> </script></onentry>
    <transition event="go" target="b"/>
  </state>
  <final id="b"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: xpath syntax error in `<script>`: `<script>` is not supported by the XPath data model
notes: the XPath data model defines no script language (SCXML CR 2014 §C.3.9 and §C.3.11), so a `<script>` raises `error.execution` and aborts the rest of its executable-content block
diagnostics.help: move each assignment into `<assign location="$var" expr="…"/>` (and each message into `<log>`), then remove the `<script>`
spec_references: SCXML CR 2014 §C.3 The XPath Data Model
